Title: EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (EOI) Contractors for Construction of University Centre
NewsSummary: Building on its global success, the university plans to add new campuses, programmes and facilities in Nairobi, Kampala, Arusha and Dar es Salaam.
NewsContent:
EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (EOI)
Contractors for Construction of University Centre

ABOUT AGA KHAN UNIVERSITY
Aga Khan University (AKU) is a private not-for-profit institution ofnhigher education that bridges the dual realities of global knowledgenand expertise and local capacity development. As part of the Aga Khan Development Network, AKU is committed to bringing international standards of excellence in teaching, research and healthcare to local communities around the world to help them improve their quality of life.

Building on its global success, the university plans to add new campuses, programmes and facilities in Nairobi, Kampala, Arusha and Dar es Salaam, transforming the university focus on the health sciences and education into a comprehensive university featuring an undergraduate liberal arts program and graduate professional education.

AKU is currently preparing the necessary documentation and other measures required to start the construction of the University Centre in Nairobi, comprising of three levels of basement, two multi-storey buildings of twelve and seven floors respectively.

As a prelude to commencing construction, expressions of interests are invited from construction companies that have proven track record for construction of high-rise institutional projects including structural, civil, finishing, services and infrastructure works.

SCOPE OF WORKS
The scope will include sub-structure and superstructure works including structural frame, civil works, finishing, mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP), and building management systems.

PRE-QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
Companies to provide
  • Letter of interest indicating the project reference
  • Company’s background/profile
  • Detailed company information with evidence of registration and license with a minimum of seven years existence and relevant experience
  • Audited financial statements for the last three years
  • Detailed list of similar work performed and year completed
  • Reference letters from three major projects clients
  • List of key management and technical personnel including their CVs with name/details of project manager assigned to the job
  • Additional documents: Value Added Tax (VAT) Certificate, Valid Tax Compliance Certificate and Form CR12

No payment will be made for costs incurred in the preparation and submission of a proposal in response to this per-qualification exercise. “Please note that proposals sent via email will be disqualified”
